title: SEAL: Systematic Error Analysis for Value ALignment
benchmark_measurement: Detection of religious discrimination as a feature in alignment datasets.
findings: Religious discrimination was identified as a feature within the Anthropic/hh-rlhf dataset. According to the analysis presented in the appendix (Figure 15), it is one of several types of discrimination present in the dataset, occurring less frequently than discrimination based on 'Race, Color, and Sex' or 'National Origin'. The paper does not provide further specific analysis on this finding beyond presenting its frequency.
